subject: Fwd: Overrun safeguard & pro-rated burst agreement
messages:
From: Markus Reiner <markus@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0500
Subject: Unexpected traffic spike — need temporary burst coverage

Hi Sofia,

Quick note — we had an unplanned campaign push overnight and are seeing sustained throughput about 6x our committed level for the past 10 hours. Latency is fine but we're getting throttled on some routes and worried about throttled runs for critical clinical workflows.

Can Redwood provide a short-term burst allowance or emergency uplift while we stabilize traffic and decide if we should increase our committed capacity? We need to know:
- Maximum burst tokens/sec you can allow for a 72-hour window
- Estimated per-token overage rate (or a capped-dollar path)
- How invoicing/true-up would work if this persists beyond the window

Copying procurement for visibility — Markus

--
Markus Reiner
Head of Integrations, Nimbus Health
markus@nimbushealth.com

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>
To: Markus Reiner <markus@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbushealth.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:42:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected traffic spike — need temporary burst coverage

Hi Markus — thanks for flagging (and congrats on the campaign traction). Short answer: yes, we can put an emergency safety net in place immediately. High level proposal below — attaching a short formal addendum and the usage snapshot we pulled.

Proposal (72-hr safety net, effective immediately)
- Temporary burst ceiling: +5x committed throughput (capped at 120k tokens/min across your account) for 72 hours from the time you accept the addendum.
- Overage structure: pro-rated blended rate of $0.015 / 1k tokens for burst usage within the safety net (this replaces per-token list pricing for the window).
- Escalation cap: maximum charge for the 72-hr window capped at $8,000. Any usage beyond the cap will be paused and we will notify you.
- True-up: if average daily throughput for the following 30 days remains >2x committed level, we will issue a one-time invoice to convert the burst into a provisional committed uplift (pro-rated monthly credit applied against the next invoice) or revert to normal overage pricing.

I attached: nimbus-burst-proposal-v2.pdf (addendum to your MSA) and usage-snapshot-2027-12-01.csv.

Next steps: if you confirm acceptance in writing we can activate immediately and share a DocuSign link for signature. Ben (cc) — please confirm billing & approval path on your end; Laura, looping you for quick FYI on the capped-dollar path for accounting.

Best,
Sofia
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 10:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Fw: internal: Immediate burst proposal for Nimbus Health

Internal — quick alignment:
- The proposed $0.015/1k tokens blended rate with an $8k cap is acceptable for an emergency 72-hr safety net.
- Finance (Laura): confirm we can invoice the capped-dollar amount immediately as "provisional overrun" and then true-up in the next monthly invoice.
- Karthik: ops needed to flip the rate limit and monitor; please confirm tokens/sec throttles and automatic pause threshold.

If finance approves, Sofia can send the DocuSign and we activate.

--
Ben
Director, Customer Success (covering enterprise renewals)
ben_carter@redwood-inference.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 11:20:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: internal: Immediate burst proposal for Nimbus Health

Confirming finance path:
- We can invoice a provisional charge equal to the capped amount ($8,000) immediately as an "emergency burst hold". That will appear as a separate line item and be credited pro-rata against the next monthly invoice if the uplift becomes permanent.
- If actual usage in the 72-hr window is less than the cap, we will bill the actual usage at the blended $0.015/1k tokens and issue a credit for the difference.
- Required paperwork: signed addendum (DocuSign) and a short PO/confirmation from Nimbus procurement.

Agree Ops should configure an automatic pause if usage > cap to protect both sides.

Thanks — Laura
VP, Finance Operations
laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com

From: Markus Reiner <markus@nimbushealth.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>, Elena Soto <elena.soto@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 08:40:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected traffic spike — need temporary burst coverage

Thanks all — that path looks reasonable. Quick clarifying Qs from procurement before we sign:
1) How will you measure "tokens" during the window (we need a deterministic definition for our internal billing and audit)?
2) If we hit the $8k cap before the 72 hours end and usage is still high, do you pause traffic automatically or do you throttle to committed levels?
3) Can you add a minimal 7-day notice window if you need to pause beyond the cap (we need time to route critical workflows internally)?

If you can confirm these items and provide the DocuSign link, procurement will sign the addendum and we'll route a PO.

— Markus

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com>
To: Markus Reiner <markus@nimbushealth.com>, Nimbus Health Procurement <procurement@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood-inference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood-inference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Thu, 04 Dec 2027 14:05:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Overrun safeguard & pro-rated burst agreement

Markus / Procurement — answers below and next steps.

1) Measurement: we define tokens as Redwood "inference tokens" (model input + output tokenized by the serving runtime using the same tokenizer as the model). For the addendum we will publish the token calculation snippet and include the usage CSV (attached) as the canonical snapshot. Ops will provide per-route token counts at activation for transparency.

2) Pause vs throttle: operationally we will throttle down to your committed throughput once the $8k cap is reached; we will notify you via the account Slack + email. If you prefer a hard pause we can enable that, but we generally recommend throttling so critical workflows still get degraded throughput rather than fully fail.

3) Notice window: we can commit to a 7-day notice for any proactive pause beyond the 72-hr safety net. For the immediate emergency window we will still act in real time to protect platform stability, but will follow the 7-day notice for any subsequent actions.

DocuSign link: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abc123-nimbus-burst-addendum (attached to the email and embedded in the addendum).

If procurement confirms, sign and we'll activate the safety net within 30 minutes.

Cheers,
Sofia
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood-inference.com

Attachment stubs:
- nimbus-burst-proposal-v2.pdf (Redwood addendum; includes definitions, caps, billing examples)
- usage-snapshot-2027-12-01.csv (hourly token counts for the last 48 hours)
